source_text: Interim analysis after 473 person-years of follow-up in the intervention group and 499 in the control group revealed 20 HIV infections in the circumcision arm versus 49 in the control arm, yielding a relative risk reduction of 60% (95% CI: 32–77%), prompting early termination of the trial on ethical grounds. [15]
